newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia services sector seen growing 8.4-9.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia services sector seen growing 8.4-9.0 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's services sector is expected to grow at 8.4 percent a year from 1996 to 2000 and at an annual 9.0 percent from 2001 to 2005, the government's 10-year industrial master plan said on Thursday.
The impetus for the growth from the sector is expected to come from wholesale and retail trade, hotels, business services and communications, the Second Industrial Master Plan 1996-2005 said.

With the industrial blueprint in place, the services sector is expected to "contribute significantly to growth" with its share of gross domestic product increasing from 44.3 percent in 1995 to 48.4 percent in 2005, the report said.
